homeomorphisms-1.declaration:

homeomorphisms-2.declaration:
homeomorph_inverse_continuous {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ₜ Y) : Continuous e.symm

homeomorphisms-3.declaration:
homeomorph_round_trip {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (x : X) : e.symm (e x) = x

localcharts-1.declaration:
local_chart_source_open {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) : IsOpen e.source

localcharts-2.declaration:
local_chart_continuous {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) : ContinuousOn e e.source

localcharts-3.declaration:
local_chart_maps_source {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ e.source) : e x ∈ e.target

localcharts-4.declaration:
local_chart_round_trip {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X Y) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ e.source) : e.symm (e x) = x

chartedspaces-1.declaration:
point_mem_preferred_chart {H : Type u} {M : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : x ∈ (chartAt H x).source

chartedspaces-2.declaration:
preferred_chart_mem_atlas {H : Type u} {M : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : chartAt H x ∈ atlas H M

chartedspaces-3.declaration:
preferred_chart_maps_to_target {H : Type u} {M : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : chartAt H x x ∈ (chartAt H x).target

chartedspaces-4.declaration:
preferred_chart_source_is_neighborhood {H : Type u} {M : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] (x : M) : (chartAt H x).source ∈ 𝓝 x

chartedspaces-5.declaration:
preferred_charts_cover {H : Type u} {M : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace H M] : (⋃ x : M, (chartAt H x).source) = (Set.univ : Set M)

canonicalcharts-1.declaration:
self_chart_is_identity {H : Type u} [TopologicalSpace H] (x : H) :
    chartAt H x = OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl H

canonicalcharts-2.declaration:
self_atlas_only_identity {H : Type u} [TopologicalSpace H] (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph H H) :
    e ∈ atlas H H ↔ e = OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl H

canonicalcharts-3.declaration:
product_chart_is_product {H : Type u} {H' : Type u'} {M : Type v} {M' : Type v'}
    [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace H'] [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace M']
    [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H' M'] (x : M × M') :
    chartAt (ModelProd H H') x = (chartAt H x.1).prod (chartAt H' x.2)

canonicalcharts-4.declaration:
product_point_mem_chart_source {H : Type u} {H' : Type u'} {M : Type v} {M' : Type v'}
    [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace H'] [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace M']
    [ChartedSpace H M] [ChartedSpace H' M'] (x : M) (y : M') :
    (x, y) ∈ (chartAt (ModelProd H H') (x, y)).source

smoothmanifolds-1.declaration:
model_space_is_manifold {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]

    {H : Type w} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H) (n : WithTop ℕ∞) :
    IsManifold I n H

smoothmanifolds-2.declaration:
manifold_of_higher_smoothness {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
    {H : Type w} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H}
    {M : Type u'} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    {m n : WithTop ℕ∞} [IsManifold I n M] (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsManifold I m M

smoothmanifolds-3.declaration:
smooth_manifold_is_topological {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
    {H : Type w} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H}
    {M : Type u'} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    [IsManifold I ∞ M] : IsManifold I 0 M

smoothmanifolds-4.declaration:
product_of_manifolds {𝕜 : Type u} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
    {E' : Type v'} [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E']
    {H : Type w} [TopologicalSpace H] {H' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H']
    {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {I' : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E' H'}
    {M : Type u'} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    {M' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace H' M']
    (n : WithTop ℕ∞) [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold I' n M'] :
    IsManifold (I.prod I') n (M × M')
